newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans follow CBOT up.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans follow CBOT up.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were firmer in good volume trade midsession at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with both exporters and crushers buying as the market followed Chicago higher, traders said.

Cash maize was steady in good turnover, with sellers deciding to take advantage of current prices. Cash sunflower seed rose higher on the back of soybeans in brisk trade. January wheat slumped $5 on weaker international markets and a weak FOB market. Volume was good.
